datasetVersion.termsOfAccess:
Research fields eligible for reuse of the data in this dataset:
- Kinematic validation
- Statistical shape modeling
- Biomechanical modeling

fields.value: 3D models for validation of forearm rotation kinematics

dsDescriptionValue.value: 3D models of the radius, ulna, forearm rotation axis and rotational centres at the level of the DRUJ and PRUJ obtained from 3D- and 4D-CT acquisitions in healthy volunteers.

publicationCitation.value: Kinematic analysis of forearm rotation using four-dimensional computed tomography
